arguments.subject: Your Smart Home Hub Setup Guide
arguments.body:
Hi Kevin,

Thanks for choosing our Smart Home Hub! Here’s a quick 3-step guide:

1. Unbox & Plug In:
   • Remove all packaging.
   • Connect the power adapter and wait for the LED ring to pulse.

2. Download the TechMart Smart Home App:
   • Available on the App Store & Google Play.
   • Open the app and follow the in-app wizard to add a device.

3. Connect to Wi-Fi:
   • Select your network and enter the password.
   • Once connected, the LED ring turns solid.

Tips:
• Position the Hub centrally for optimal Wi-Fi coverage.
• Insert a microSD card (up to 128 GB, sold separately) for local storage.
• To view video, tap “Cameras” in the app and follow on-screen prompts.

If you hit any snags or need a walkthrough, just reply to this email or message me here. We’re available 24/7.

Enjoy your new Hub!

Best,
TechMart Support Team
